blocks.text: MANILA – A letter to the editor posted on Inquirer.net in July, 2026, written by Fernan J. Angeles has been taken down from the Opinion channel of the site. In his letter, Angeles made claims against the Manila Electric Company (Meralco), the main claim of which focused on the alleged failure of the power distribution company to refund its customers. The decision to remove the said letter was reached after Meralco rebutted the claims made by Angeles. The rebuttal letter was sent to Inquirer and was posted immediately.
